top_signals.title: Oil Holds Gains, Asian Stocks Set for Muted Open: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Oil held onto a rally as hopes faded for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while Asian stocks were set for a muted start ahead of key US inflation reports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin puts privacy and quantum resistance front and center in Ethereum’s latest roadmap
top_signals.summary: Buterin previously said the upgrades included in Lean Ethereum will form the protocol's “third major iteration.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
